bagPolicy.summary: Stanford Athletics has implemented a Clear Bag Policy to enhance safety and expedite security screenings. Approved bags include clear plastic, vinyl, or PVC bags up to 12"x6"x12" and small clutches no larger than 4.5"x6.5".
allowed: clear plastic, vinyl, or PVC bags up to 12"x6"x12"
small clutch bags or purses no larger than 4.5"x6.5"
bagPolicy.note: Special considerations for medically necessary items and diaper bags, which may be subject to additional screening.

parking.note: Football parking locations and entry routes are event-specific. Review Stanford's current gameday guide and parking map before arrival; prepaid permits may be required for designated lots.

rideshare.note: For football games, Waymo runs a designated drop-off and pickup spot at the Oval; book rides in the Waymo app. Concerts can differ, so check your event page.

concessions.note: Fixed and portable concession locations sell food and beverages throughout Stanford Stadium. Concessions are cashless, and selection varies by event.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Wheelchair and companion seating is available. For football games, relocations into ADA seats on game day are limited and first come, first served, and ADA shuttle carts run from select spots near the stadium to Gate 4, starting 30 minutes before gates open. Concerts can differ, so check your event page.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: For football games, you can re-enter through any gate until the end of the third quarter. Scan your ticket out when you leave and go through security again when you return. Concerts can differ, so check your event page.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: The Athletics Ticket Office is at Gate 2. It opens 3 hours before kickoff on football game days and 9 AM to 4 PM PT, Monday to Friday; call (800)-STANFORD with questions. Download your mobile tickets before you arrive, since screenshots aren't accepted.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: For Stanford football games, the Athletics Ticket Office is at Gate 2, ADA shuttle carts drop guests off mainly at Gate 4, and Bag Drop near Gate 10 opens 30 minutes before gates open. Concerts can differ, so check your event page.
